8. Cost at list prices (estimate)
  ESTIMATE at list prices (src/pricing.ts, last verified 2026-09-30): the same token counts priced at the model sent vs the model requested.
  That assumes the requested model would have used the same tokens; it does not (Sonnet 5 wrote 2.7x Opus 5.5's output on the same tasks, observations.md). The measured line below replaces it where REFLEX_AB ran.
  Not modelled: tokenizer differences between models, cache TTL (writes priced at the 5-minute rate), discounts, subscription limits.
  The requested-model figure prices the routed model's cache writes as writes on the requested model too, although its cache was usually already warm from side calls (observations.md, cache cost model), so it overstates what staying would have cost.
    main chat + subagent requests   n     tokens  usage at sent as % of at requested
    routed only                     5    251,518                               27.5%
    all (unrouted count as equal)  18  1,087,320                               77.0%
  Dollar amounts: rerun with --usd. Without it only relative usage is shown.
  measured (REFLEX_AB): no randomised turns; the rows above are the only estimate, and they assume equal token counts
  Side calls are excluded here and shown in section 9.
  delegation: no session ran with the hint (REFLEX_DELEGATE=1); nothing to compare

12. Side-call routing estimate
  ESTIMATE, not a measurement: what sending no_tools, notification, suggestion to one shared cheaper tier would have cost, over the tokens actually recorded.
  A call is warm only when the previous routable side call of the same conversation was inside the cache TTL; nothing else would keep that tier warm. Cold calls pay a full write of the whole prompt.
  A call whose prompt exceeds the target tier's context ceiling cannot be routed there at all and is counted under "over ceiling", never in the saving.

  candidates (net = conversations ever pinned below the requested tier carved out, removing the warm-cache interaction), at both cache TTLs since the log does not record one for these calls, or records both:
    tier    ceiling  TTL  routable  over ceiling  $ at requested  $ at tier  $ saved gross  $ saved net
    haiku   150,000   5m         3             -         $0.1968    $0.1797        $0.0171      $0.0125
    haiku   150,000   1h         3             -         $0.2748    $0.2868       $-0.0120     $-0.0009
    sonnet     none   5m         3             -         $0.1968    $0.3593       $-0.1625     $-0.0783
    sonnet     none   1h         3             -         $0.2748    $0.5735       $-0.2987     $-0.1455

  haiku (ceiling 150,000; TTL per request, none recorded so 5m assumed):
    side kind   routable  warm  cold  over ceiling   tokens  cache read  gap p50
    suggestion         2     0     2             -  142,844       91.7%        -
    no_tools           1     1     0             -    9,011        0.0%      1 s
    suggestion: 0.0 warm per cold against break-even 3.1 - BELOW it, COSTS $0.0384
